stops.title: Your overview
stops.caption: Only what belongs to you.
stops.speech: This is your overview. Everything here is yours: your groups, your attendance, and whatever the church needs from you this week.

stops.title: What you can see
stops.caption: A short sidebar is not a missing feature.
stops.speech: Your sidebar is short because most of Kairos is not yours to run. Nothing is hidden from you out of secrecy.

stops.title: Your attendance
stops.caption: Every service you have been marked at.
stops.speech: My Attendance shows every service you were recorded at, your current streak, and how your attendance looks over the last few weeks.

stops.title: Your fellowship
stops.caption: The small group you belong to.
stops.speech: Fellowships shows the group you belong to, when it meets and where. If you are not in one yet, the map will find you the nearest.

stops.title: Your departments
stops.caption: The teams you serve on.
stops.speech: Departments lists the teams you serve on, when you are next on the rota, and the uniform for that service if there is one.

stops.title: Checking in
stops.caption: Scan, and you are marked present.
stops.speech: When you arrive, open Check in and scan the code on the screen at the door. That marks you present without queueing at the desk.

stops.title: Forms
stops.caption: Baptism, testimony, a first visit.
stops.speech: Forms is where you ask for a baptism, share a testimony, or register somebody visiting for the first time. A leader picks it up from there.

stops.title: Your profile
stops.caption: Your details, and who can see them.
stops.speech: Your profile holds your contact details and your settings, including the language Kairos speaks to you in.
